name: jira-to-md
description: Download Jira issues and whole epics as Markdown files, edit them in VS Code, and publish them back to Jira.

jiraToMd.token.description: API token (Cloud) or Personal Access Token (Server/DC).

jiraToMd.downloadFolder.description: Where to save issues. Empty = the active file's folder. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

jiraToMd.askSubfolder.description: Ask for an optional subfolder of the download folder, e.g. services/account.

jiraToMd.sync.markdownDescription: What **Publish** sends to an issue the file is bound to, and what **Pull** and **Download** bring back. A new issue always gets its summary and description.

summary.description: Summary: the # heading of the file.

description.description: Description: the rest of the file, with its Mermaid diagrams as images.

comments.description: Comments: the Comments section at the end of the file.

attachments.description: Files: attachments of the issue, downloaded next to the file, and files the file links to, uploaded.

enumDescriptions: Always HTML, for Jira description fields edited in a rich-text editor.
Always Jira wiki markup, for the standard Jira editor.
HTML when the issue's description (or the epic's, for a new issue) is HTML, wiki markup otherwise.
jiraToMd.descriptionFormat.description: The format Push sends the description in.

scripts.test: node test/client-test.js && node test/wiki-test.js && node test/html-test.js && node test/file-names-test.js && node test/preview-button-test.js && node test/commands-test.js
